name: Createdump.exe
description: Microsoft .NET Runtime Crash Dump Generator (included in .NET Core)
author: mr.d0x, Daniel Santos

commands.description: Dump process by PID and create a minidump file. If "-f dump.dmp" is not specified, the file is created as '%TEMP%\dump.%p.dmp' where %p is the PID of the target process.
commands.usecase: Dump process memory contents using PID.

detection: createdump.exe process with a command line containing the lsass.exe process id
